title: [Đề 02] Thực Hành Kỹ Năng Trọng Tâm Bậc 3 — Tập 1 (Work Experience & Older Students)
description: Tập 1 bài thực hành chuyên sâu 4 kỹ năng bám sát cấu trúc VNU Tests Tiếng Anh Bậc 3: Work Experience for Students (Part 2), Being an Older Student (Part 3), Device-Centered Communication (Part 4), Organizing a Party & Home-Cooked vs Sugary Food (Writing), kèm trọn bộ Audio chuẩn định dạng.

tasks.title: Part 1: Signs & Notices
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. Choose the best answer (A, B, or C) that matches the meaning of each sign or notice in standard B1 format.

questions.prompt:
NOTICE
Do not leave any vehicles, including bicycles, against this wall.

options.text: You must not park cars or bikes next to this wall.
Only bicycles are allowed to be parked against this wall.
Vehicles can wait here for a short time.

questions.explanationVi: Biển báo số 1: 'Do not leave any vehicles, including bicycles, against this wall' (Không để bất kỳ phương tiện nào, kể cả xe đạp, dựa sát bức tường này). Đáp án chính thức: 1. A.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: phương tiện giao thông, xe cộ

questions.prompt:
CITY CAR HIRE
All drivers must be over 21 and hold a valid driving license for at least two years.

options.text: Anyone over 21 can rent a car even if they just passed their driving test.
You can rent a car for up to two years if you have a license.
To rent a car, you must be over 21 and have had a driving license for two years or more.

questions.explanationVi: Biển báo số 2: Người thuê xe phải trên 21 tuổi và có bằng lái hợp lệ tối thiểu 2 năm. Đáp án chính thức: 2. C.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: dịch vụ thuê xe ô tô
bằng lái xe còn hiệu lực

questions.prompt:
STAFF NEEDED
Part-time waiters required for weekend shifts.
No experience necessary as full training is provided.

options.text: Applicants must have worked in a restaurant before.
The restaurant will train new part-time staff who work on weekends.
Full-time waiters are needed from Monday to Friday.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo tuyển dụng số 3: Cần nhân viên phục vụ bán thời gian dịp cuối tuần, không cần kinh nghiệm vì sẽ được đào tạo đầy đủ ('full training is provided'). Đáp án chính thức: 3. B.

questions.prompt:
OFFICE SECURITY
Visitors must sign in at the reception desk and wear a visitor badge at all times.

options.text: Guests have to register at reception and keep their badge on while in the building.
Office workers must get a new badge at the reception desk every morning.
Visitors only need to wear a badge when they are at the reception desk.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo an ninh văn phòng số 4: Khách đến thăm phải đăng ký tại quầy lễ tân ('sign in at the reception desk') và luôn đeo thẻ khách ('wear a visitor badge at all times'). Đáp án chính thức: 4. A.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: ký tên đăng ký khi vào

questions.prompt:
SAMMY'S RESTAURANT
Book a table for 4 or more people before 6 p.m. and receive a free bottle of house wine!

options.text: Every customer dining before 6 p.m. gets a free glass of wine.
Groups of at least four people who reserve early get free wine.
You can only book a table at Sammy's Restaurant if you have four people.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo nhà hàng Sammy's: Đặt bàn cho nhóm từ 4 người trở lên trước 6 giờ chiều sẽ được tặng 1 chai rượu vang miễn phí. Đáp án B đúng.

questions.prompt:
TERRACE CAFÉ
Closed for painting this Monday and Tuesday.
Reopening Wednesday at 8 a.m. with a brand-new breakfast menu!

options.text: Terrace Café will serve its new breakfast menu starting on Wednesday morning.
Customers can only order breakfast on Monday and Tuesday while the café is painted.
The café is moving to a new building on Wednesday.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo Terrace Café: Đóng cửa sơn sửa thứ Hai và thứ Ba, mở cửa lại lúc 8 giờ sáng thứ Tư với thực đơn bữa sáng hoàn toàn mới. Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt:
WEEKLY TO-DO LIST — REMINDER
Don't forget to submit your monthly travel expense form to the Accounting Department by Friday 4 p.m.

options.text: The Accounting Department is closed all day on Friday.
Staff must hand in their travel cost claims before 4 p.m. on Friday.
You should book your business trip before Friday afternoon.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo nhắc nhở: Đừng quên nộp mẫu đơn chi phí công tác tháng cho Phòng Kế toán trước 4 giờ chiều thứ Sáu. Đáp án B đúng.

tasks.title: Part 2: Work Experience
tasks.instructions: Read the text below about work experience for students and choose the best word (A, B, or C) for each blank from 8 to 15.

passage.title: Work Experience for Students
passage.text:
Going out into the world of work for a week or two is a great way for secondary school and university students to find out what a real job is like. Work experience helps young people learn (8) ________ different careers and discover what kind of work they enjoy doing.

Before starting your placement, it is important to (9) ________ some research about the company. Find out what products or services they offer and check the best route to travel there so that you do not arrive (10) ________ on your first morning.

During your work experience, you should always be polite and enthusiastic. Don't be afraid to (11) ________ questions if you do not understand how to do a task. Employers do not expect you to know everything immediately, (12) ________ they do expect you to listen carefully and try your best. It is also a good idea to keep a daily notebook to write down the new skills you have (13) ________.

At the end of the placement, remember to thank the staff (14) ________ helping you. Having good work experience on your CV will make a strong impression and help you (15) ________ a full-time job more easily in the future.

questions.prompt: Work experience helps young people learn (8) ________ different careers and discover what kind of work they enjoy doing.
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'learn about something' (tìm hiểu về điều gì). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 1. B.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: kỳ thực tập / trải nghiệm công việc thực tế

questions.prompt: Before starting your placement, it is important to (9) ________ some research about the company.
questions.explanationVi: Collocation cố định: 'do research' (thực hiện tìm hiểu/nghiên cứu). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 2. A.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: nghiên cứu, tìm hiểu thông tin

questions.prompt: ...check the best route to travel there so that you do not arrive (10) ________ on your first morning.
questions.explanationVi: 'arrive late' (đến muộn). 'lately' có nghĩa là 'gần đây'. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 3. C.

questions.prompt: Don't be afraid to (11) ________ questions if you do not understand how to do a task.
questions.explanationVi: Collocation: 'ask questions' (đặt câu hỏi). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 4. A.

questions.prompt: Employers do not expect you to know everything immediately, (12) ________ they do expect you to listen carefully and try your best.
questions.explanationVi: Liên từ 'but' (nhưng) nối hai mệnh đề tương phản: nhà tuyển dụng không kỳ vọng bạn biết mọi thứ ngay lập tức, nhưng họ kỳ vọng bạn lắng nghe kỹ và cố gắng hết sức. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 5. B.

questions.prompt: It is also a good idea to keep a daily notebook to write down the new skills you have (13) ________.
questions.explanationVi: 'skills you have learned' (những kỹ năng mới mà bạn đã học được). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 6. C.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: đợt thực tập tại doanh nghiệp

questions.prompt: At the end of the placement, remember to thank the staff (14) ________ helping you.
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'thank somebody for doing something' (cảm ơn ai vì đã làm gì). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 7. B.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: cảm ơn ai vì điều gì

questions.prompt: Having good work experience on your CV will make a strong impression and help you (15) ________ a full-time job more easily in the future.
questions.explanationVi: 'find a full-time job' (tìm được một công việc toàn thời gian). 'look' phải đi kèm giới từ 'for'. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 8. A.

tasks.title: Part 3: Being an Older Student
tasks.instructions: Read the passage about returning to university as an older student and decide whether statements 16 to 20 are True (A) or False (B).

passage.title: Being an Older Student
passage.text:
At the age of 32, I finally decided to return to university to study History. When I walked into my first lecture hall, almost everyone else was 18 or 19 years old. At first, I worried that I wouldn't fit in or that my brain had forgotten how to study after working in an office for over ten years.

However, I soon realized that being a mature student has many advantages. Unlike younger students who were living away from home for the first time and spending a lot of time going to parties, I knew exactly why I was there. My years of office work had taught me how to manage my time effectively, so I always started my essays early and never missed a deadline.

In seminar discussions, I felt confident sharing my opinions with the professors because I had more life experience. Although I couldn't join the student sports clubs in the evenings because I had to go home to cook dinner for my two children, I made several good friends in my study group. Going back to university in my thirties was one of the best decisions I have ever made.

questions.prompt: Most of the other students in the writer's class were much younger than her.
questions.explanationVi: Tác giả 32 tuổi và viết: 'almost everyone else was 18 or 19 years old' (hầu hết các sinh viên khác đều 18–19 tuổi, trẻ hơn tác giả rất nhiều). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 1. T (A).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: sinh viên lớn tuổi (đi học đại học muộn)

questions.prompt: The writer often handed in her university essays late because she had forgotten how to study.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 2 viết: 'so I always started my essays early and never missed a deadline' (luôn làm bài luận sớm và không bao giờ trễ hạn). Nhận định là SAI. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 2. F (B).

questions.prompt: The writer was too shy to speak with her professors during seminar discussions.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 3 viết: 'In seminar discussions, I felt confident sharing my opinions with the professors' (cảm thấy tự tin chia sẻ ý kiến với các giáo sư). Nhận định là SAI. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 3. F (B).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: buổi thảo luận chuyên đề ở đại học

questions.prompt: Family responsibilities prevented the writer from joining evening sports clubs at university.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 3 viết: 'I couldn't join the student sports clubs in the evenings because I had to go home to cook dinner for my two children'. Nhận định là ĐÚNG. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 4. T (A).

questions.prompt: The writer feels happy about her decision to return to university in her thirties.
questions.explanationVi: Câu cuối bài: 'Going back to university in my thirties was one of the best decisions I have ever made'. Nhận định là ĐÚNG. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 5. T (A).

tasks.title: Part 4: Device-Centered Communication
tasks.instructions: Read the passage about smartphones and face-to-face communication and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for questions 21 to 25.

passage.title: Device-Centered Communication
passage.text:
Walk into any coffee shop or university campus today, and you will see groups of friends sitting together in silence, each staring at their own smartphone screen. While mobile technology has made it easier than ever to stay in touch with people across the globe, psychologists warn that device-centered communication is weakening our face-to-face relationships.

Professor Sherry Turkle, a researcher who studies technology and human behavior, found that even placing a silent phone on the table during a conversation changes what people talk about. When a phone is visible, people tend to keep topics light and superficial because they feel they might be interrupted at any moment. Deep, meaningful conversations require undivided attention and empathy—qualities that are hard to develop through short text messages and emojis.

To rebuild genuine connections, experts recommend creating 'device-free zones' in daily life. For example, families can agree to put away all phones during dinner, and friends can stack their phones in the middle of the table when meeting at a café. Spending just one hour a day talking without digital distractions can significantly improve both our friendships and our emotional well-being.

questions.prompt: What problem do psychologists warn about in paragraph 1?

options.text: Overusing smartphones is harming our real-life conversations and relationships.
Smartphones are too expensive for university students to buy.
Coffee shops are becoming too noisy because of phone calls.

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 1 nêu rõ: 'psychologists warn that device-centered communication is weakening our face-to-face relationships'. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 1. A.

questions.prompt: According to Professor Sherry Turkle, what happens when a phone is on the table during a chat?

options.text: People talk more honestly about their personal feelings.
People speak louder so others can hear them.
People avoid deep topics because they expect to be interrupted.

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 2 viết: 'When a phone is visible, people tend to keep topics light and superficial because they feel they might be interrupted at any moment'. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 2. C.

questions.prompt: The word 'undivided' in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ________.
questions.explanationVi: 'undivided attention' có nghĩa là sự chú ý trọn vẹn, tập trung hoàn toàn không bị phân tâm ('complete and focused'). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 3. C.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: sự chú ý trọn vẹn, không phân tâm

questions.prompt: Which of the following is suggested as a 'device-free zone' in paragraph 3?

options.text: Deleting all social media apps from your smartphone
Putting away phones during family dinner time
Only using smartphones in coffee shops

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 3 gợi ý: 'families can agree to put away all phones during dinner'. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 4. B.

questions.prompt: What is the main message of the passage?

options.text: Text messages and emojis are the best way to express empathy.
Reducing digital distractions helps us build stronger real-life connections.
Universities should ban smartphones on campus.

questions.explanationVi: Thông điệp chính của toàn bài là việc hạn chế sự xao nhãng từ thiết bị điện tử giúp chúng ta xây dựng kết nối thực tế sâu sắc hơn. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 5. B.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: sự xao nhãng, thứ gây phân tâm

tasks.title: Part 3: Extended Recordings
tasks.instructions: Listen to the official VNU Press extended recordings (Track 14: History Assignment & Track 15: Helping Others) TWICE and decide whether statements 15 to 20 are Correct (A) or Incorrect (B).
tasks.transcript:
[Track 8 - Celine & Sarah]:
Celine and Sarah are talking about their weekend plans. Celine is excited about going to the new art gallery on Saturday morning, while Sarah says she has to finish her marketing report first and will join Celine for lunch afterward.

[Track 14 - Practice 1: Alice & Bob on History Assignment]:
Alice: Hi Bob, have you started working on our History presentation about the Industrial Revolution yet?
Bob: Yes, Alice! I spent yesterday afternoon in the university library reading two books about steam engines and factories in 19th-century Britain. We have plenty of material!
Alice: That's great. Did Professor Smith say we have to submit the slides this Friday?
Bob: No, he extended the deadline to next Tuesday, so we still have five days to prepare. Also, instead of writing a long essay, we only need to give a 10-minute presentation with slides.

[Track 15 - Practice 2: Scientific Studies on Helping Others]:
Speaker: Many people think that spending money on themselves will make them happiest, or that volunteering takes too much free time. However, recent psychological studies show the opposite. Researchers found that people who spend just two hours a week helping others or doing charity work experience lower stress levels and much higher life satisfaction. In fact, helping other people activates the reward center in our brain and improves both mental and physical health.

questions.prompt: [Track 14 - Trang 83, Câu 1] Alice and Bob are preparing a History assignment about the Industrial Revolution.
questions.explanationVi: Track 14 Câu 1: Alice hỏi Bob 'have you started working on our History presentation about the Industrial Revolution yet?'. Nhận định là ĐÚNG (Correct). Đáp án chính thức: 1. A.

questions.prompt: [Track 14 - Trang 83, Câu 2] Bob couldn't find any useful books in the university library.

tasks.title: Task 1: Steps to Organize a Party
tasks.instructions: Write a paragraph of at least 80 words describing the steps to organize a party based on the prompts in standard B1 format.

writingPrompts.title: Steps to Organize a Party
writingPrompts.instructions: Write a paragraph of at least 80 words about how to organize a successful party.

dataCard.Step 1 (Planning): Set a date, time, budget, and make a guest list
dataCard.Step 2 (Invitations): Send invitations to friends at least a week in advance
dataCard.Step 3 (Food & Drinks): Go shopping and prepare snacks, main dishes, and drinks
dataCard.Step 4 (Decoration & Music): Clean the house, decorate the room, and prepare a music playlist

writingPrompts.sampleAnswer: Organizing a memorable party requires careful preparation and a few clear steps. First of all, you need to decide on the date, time, and budget for the party, as well as make a list of guests you want to invite. Second, you should send invitations to your friends at least one week early so they can arrange their schedules. Third, the day before the party, it is important to go to the supermarket to buy ingredients and prepare delicious snacks, food, and drinks. Finally, before the guests arrive, you should clean the living room, hang up some colorful decorations, and turn on a cheerful music playlist. Following these steps will ensure everyone has a wonderful time.

writingPrompts.instructions: Choose ONE topic and write a paragraph of at least 100 words.

topicChoices.topic: Write a paragraph of at least 100 words about the advantages of eating home-cooked food.
guidelines: Healthier and more hygienic because we choose fresh ingredients
Saves a lot of money compared to eating at restaurants
Brings family members closer together during mealtime

topicChoices.topic: Write a paragraph of at least 100 words about solutions to stop children from watching too much TV.
guidelines: Parents should set clear daily screen-time limits (e.g., 1 hour a day)
Encourage children to play outdoor sports and read books
Spend more family time talking and playing board games together

writingPrompts.sampleAnswer: Eating home-cooked meals brings many important benefits for both our health and our family life. First of all, cooking at home is much healthier than eating out because we can select fresh vegetables and meat and control the amount of oil, salt, and sugar in our dishes. Secondly, preparing food at home helps people save a significant amount of money every month compared to ordering expensive restaurant meals or fast food. Finally, cooking and sharing dinner at home gives family members a warm opportunity to talk, share their daily stories, and strengthen family bonds. For these reasons, everyone should try to maintain the habit of cooking at home regularly.

speakingPrompts.title: Social Interaction Questions (Hometown, Health & Environment)
speakingPrompts.instructions: Speak naturally and give reasons for your answers.
questions: Where is your hometown, and what is it famous for?
What do you usually do to stay healthy and keep fit?
What is the most popular means of transport in your city?
What environmental problems are affecting your city nowadays?
What is your favorite traditional festival in Vietnam?

tasks.title: Part 2: Cue Card Description
tasks.instructions: Choose ONE card below, prepare for 1 minute, speak for 1.5–2 minutes, and answer the follow-up questions.

cueCards.title: Describe a family member who you are closest to.
prompts: Who this person is and what they look like
What activities you often do together
Why you feel so close to this family member
furtherQuestions: Do you think family is more important than friends? Why?
How have family relationships changed in Vietnam in recent years?
cueCards.sampleResponse: The family member I am closest to is my mother. She is in her fifties, has a warm smile, and works as a primary school teacher. Every weekend, we go to the local market together and cook dinner for our family. I feel closest to her because she is very patient, always listens to my problems, and gives me helpful advice about my studies and life.

cueCards.title: Describe a wonderful holiday experience you had (e.g., in Da Nang — Trang 95).
prompts: Where and when you went on this holiday
Who you went with and what you did there
Why it was a memorable holiday for you
furtherQuestions: Do you prefer traveling with family or with friends?
What should tourists do to protect the environment when traveling?
cueCards.sampleResponse: Last summer, I had a wonderful four-day holiday in Da Nang with my best friends. We swam at My Khe Beach, visited the Golden Bridge in Ba Na Hills, and walked around Hoi An Ancient Town in the evening. It was unforgettable because the seafood was delicious, the local people were kind, and it helped us relax after our university exams.
